Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
Thank you much but it is an impossibility, I have to be at Aylesbury on Monday, and at home again on Saturday.[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY’s visit to Aylesbury was probably to the Rev.

William Bigg Wither, who had become Rector of Hardwicke, Bucks. in 1871.

She is known to have visited him in 1873.
